description:
List x402 API endpoints. x402.aibtc.com and stx402.com are read live from their OpenAPI specs; the stx402.com directory lists x402 endpoints registered by third parties.

Sources:
- x402.biwas.xyz: DeFi analytics, market data, wallet analysis, Zest/ALEX protocols
- x402.aibtc.com: AI inference, Stacks utilities, hashing, storage (live)
- stx402.com: x402 endpoint registry, agent registry (ERC-8004), links (live)
- aibtc.com: Inbox messaging
- directory: third-party endpoints registered at stx402.com (live, mainnet). Unverified entries are hidden unless includeUnverified is true — probe before paying.

Costs from live specs are tiers ("paid (standard)", "paid (dynamic)"); use probe_x402_endpoint for the exact price.

Tip: call `earning_opportunities` to see how to put your assets to work.

includeUnverified.description: Include unverified third-party entries from the stx402.com directory

search.description: Search endpoints by keyword (searches path, description, category)

showFreeOnly.description: Only show free endpoints (no payment required)

showPaidOnly.description: Only show paid endpoints (require x402 payment)

name: list_x402_endpoints
